skill.name: theme-factory
skill.description: Apply curated color palettes and font pairings to slide decks, documents, reports, landing pages, and other visual artifacts.
skill.summary: Style artifacts with preset or custom professional themes.
skill.author: Azeem-2

content.value_statement: Many artifacts look inconsistent because colors and fonts are chosen one piece at a time. Theme Factory gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code reusable theme guidance for polished visual work.
actual_capabilities: Shows a bundled theme showcase so users can compare available visual styles.
Guides users through choosing one of ten named preset themes.
Applies theme colors and fonts to slide decks, documents, reports, and landing pages.
Reads bundled theme specifications with color hex codes and font pairings.
Creates a new custom theme when none of the preset themes fit the artifact.
limitations: It provides design guidance but does not include automation scripts for editing files directly.
Theme quality depends on the assistant correctly applying colors and fonts to the target artifact.
The bundled PDF showcase requires a viewer and may need manual review in restricted environments.
It does not verify accessibility beyond instructing the assistant to check contrast and readability.

use_cases.title: Refresh a client presentation
use_cases.description: Apply a polished theme to an existing slide deck while keeping the message and structure unchanged.

use_cases.title: Create consistent report styling
use_cases.description: Use a preset palette and font pairing to make recurring reports look consistent across teams.

use_cases.title: Build a custom launch theme
use_cases.description: Generate a new visual theme from product, audience, or brand direction when presets are not enough.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a preset theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner user wants to browse options before editing an artifact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the available Theme Factory themes and help me choose one for my presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a selected theme
prompt_templates.scenario: User already knows which theme they want.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the Ocean Depths theme to this slide deck. Keep the content unchanged and improve visual consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Match a theme to an audience
prompt_templates.scenario: User wants recommendation based on context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a Theme Factory preset for an executive strategy report about cybersecurity investment. Explain why it fits.

prompt_templates.title: Create and apply a custom theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced user needs a theme beyond the presets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a premium healthcare analytics product, show the palette and fonts for review, then apply it after I approve.

output_examples.input: Apply Tech Innovation to an AI product launch deck.
output_examples.output: The deck uses dark backgrounds, electric blue accents, neon cyan highlights, and DejaVu Sans typography for a modern technology look.

output_examples.input: Recommend a theme for a finance report.
output_examples.output: Ocean Depths is a strong fit because it uses calm navy and teal tones that support trust, clarity, and professional reporting.

output_examples.input: Create a theme for a warm nonprofit donor update.
output_examples.output: A custom theme could use soft cream backgrounds, warm amber accents, deep green headings, and readable sans-serif body text.

best_practices: Review the theme showcase before applying a theme to important deliverables.
Keep one theme consistent across the full artifact unless the user requests sections with distinct styles.
Check contrast and readability after applying colors to text, charts, and backgrounds.
anti_patterns: Do not mix several preset themes in one artifact without a clear design reason.
Do not change the artifact message while applying visual styling.
Do not skip user confirmation before applying a custom generated theme.

faq.question: What does Theme Factory do?
faq.answer: It helps an assistant apply curated color palettes and font pairings to visual artifacts.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: It includes ten preset themes, each with colors, typography, and suggested use cases.

faq.question: Can it create a new theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate a custom theme from user-provided style, audience, or brand direction.

faq.question: Does it edit slide files automatically?
faq.answer: The skill provides instructions and design specifications. Actual editing depends on the assistant and available tools.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is the bundled showcase required?
faq.answer: It is recommended for browsing themes visually, but the Markdown theme files contain the core specifications.
